trust_decision.summary: Whether an attacker-supplied remote/local name may be used as a filename component is decided by validating it as a cluster name in the remote handlers (microceph/api/remote.go) and again at each file sink: the generic Config.WriteConfig/GetPath, DeleteRemoteDb and writeRemotePeerToken.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the remote-import API; cmdRemotePut hands req.Name and req.LocalName straight to renderConfAndKeyringFiles, which builds '<name>.conf' and '<name>.keyring' under the ceph conf dir, so this call is what a reader of the summary inspects first.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared by the three remote handlers — validateRemoteName / validateRemoteImportRequest helpers (new in the fix)
every Config.WriteConfig caller: remote import (microceph/api/remote.go:145,159), UpdateConfig (microceph/ceph/config.go:421,444), ganesha/radosgw/bootstrap configs

fix_sites.module_kind: ceph subsystem file sink (rbd mirror peer token)

fix_sites.entry_point: same replication route — file descriptor never closed; the fix adds defer file.Close()
fix_sites.module_kind: resource handling in the same sink

fix_sites.entry_point: shared validator IsValidClusterName used by the handlers, DeleteRemoteDb and writeRemotePeerToken

fix_sites.module_kind: database helper that also removes conf files

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /1.0/cluster (CLI: microceph cluster export <remote-name>) — cmdClusterGet; an existing regexp check is replaced/tightened

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The generic Config.WriteConfig is shared plumbing for radosgw/ganesha/bootstrap configs and is not part of the remote-import API, so a solver can scope the fix to the remote handlers and call this lower-level writer out of scope, trusting the handler-level name check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An absent/empty remote name on GET /1.0/client/remotes means 'list all remotes'; unconditionally rejecting a name that does not match ^[a-z0-9]+$ at the top of cmdRemoteGet (or inside GetRemoteDb) breaks `microceph remote list`. The published fix guards with an explicit `if remoteName != ""`.

O6_input_shapes: URL path segment name for GET/DELETE (percent-decoded with url.PathUnescape) and now the PUT route name
JSON body remote name (req.Name), independent of the route name
route name and body name disagree (PUT client/remotes/<A> with body name <B>)
JSON body local name (req.LocalName), written into the keyring as client.<local_name>
reserved names ceph / ganesha / radosgw: syntactically valid cluster names that collide with fixed files in the conf dir
over-long names (the new regex caps cluster names at 63 chars)
config filenames ../escaped, /tmp/absolute and subdir/escaped (rejected at the generic writer)
empty name (list-all) which must keep working

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the read side of the mirror peer token path (peerBootstrapImport) builds ConfPath/rbd_mirror/<name>_peer_keyring with no validation; a caller that does not first go through writeRemotePeerToken would traverse
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix hardens the write half at microceph/ceph/rbd_mirror.go:709 while the identical path construction two functions away is untouched, so a maintainer adding a re-import/repair command would copy the unvalidated form.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the CephFS mirror peer bootstrap could persist its token to a file named from remoteName, exactly like the RBD path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: both replication paths mint a bootstrap token; the CephFS one currently only passes it as an argv value, so mirroring the RBD token-file design is the natural next change and would repeat the same sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a client/remotes/{name}/token or .../keyring GET/PUT route that serves or rewrites the per-remote files
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the endpoint already exposes per-name GET and DELETE and the files live in a known dir; a per-remote file-download route is the obvious extension and would need the same validator.

O9_family: CWE-23 relative path traversal (untrusted remote/local name used as a filename component)

(CI job unit-tests, .github/workflows/tests.yml:173-196); system/DSL suites need LXD+snapd and are not used for unit behaviour.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sanitise req.Name (filepath.Base / regex) inside cmdRemotePut or filepath.Clean inside renderConfAndKeyringFiles and stop, leaving the DELETE route's os.Remove, the generic Config.WriteConfig, writeRemotePeerToken and the reserved names (ceph/ganesha/radosgw) open.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit also edits tests/scripts/adoptutils.sh (snap glob path in the adopt CI helper); that is test infrastructure, not the protection, and is excluded from the source count.
